parts.text: In this experiment you will investigate reflection of light through a transparent block. Carry out the following instructions referring to Fig. 4.1. Fig. 4.1

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Place the transparent block, largest face down, on the ray-trace sheet supplied. The block should be on the top half of the paper. Draw the outline of the block and label it ABCD .

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Remove the block and draw the normal NN' to side CD so that the normal is 2.0 cm from C . Label the point E where NN' crosses CD .

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Draw the line EF at an angle of incidence i = 20 ° as shown in Fig. 4.1.

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) Place the paper on the pin board. Stand the plane mirror vertically and in contact with face AB of the block as shown in Fig. 4.1.

parts.label: e
parts.text: (e) Push two pins P 1 and P 2 into line EF . Pin P 1 should be about 1 cm from the block and pin P 2 some distance from the block.

parts.label: f
parts.text: (f) Replace the block and observe the images of P 1 and P 2 through side CD of the block from the direction indicated by the eye in Fig. 4.1 so that the images of P 1 and P 2 appear one behind the other. Push two pins P 3 and P 4 into the surface, between your eye and the block, so that P 3 , P 4 and the images of P 1 and P 2 , seen through the block, appear in line. Mark the positions of P 1 , P 2 , P 3 and P 4 . Remove the block.

parts.label: g
parts.text: (g) Continue the line joining the positions of P 1 and P 2 so that it crosses CD and extends as far as side AB .

parts.label: h
parts.text: (h) Draw a line joining the positions of P 3 and P 4 . Continue the line so that it crosses CD and extends as far as side AB . Label the point G where this line crosses the line from P 1 and P 2 .

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Remove the pins, block and mirror from the ray trace sheet. Measure the acute angle θ between the lines meeting at G . θ = ................................................. [1]
